title: Mitigating Bias for Question Answering Models by Tracking Bias Influence
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured stereotyping biases in question-answering models, specifically assessing whether a model's predictions reflect negative associations with specific religious groups.
findings: The proposed method, BMBI, significantly reduces the magnitude of religious bias for both classification-based and generation-based QA models. For the 'Religion' category, the bias score was reduced by up to 15.7 points in disambiguated contexts for the generation-based model, and 12.4 points for the classification-based model.
